assets.prompt:
GENERATE A BRAND-NEW CLEAN CHARACTER TURNAROUND FROM SCRATCH, not an edit/restoration/upscale of the supplied sheet. Reference image is IDENTITY REFERENCE ONLY for TILTSTAR's original cute face/proportions/palette. Do not copy its pixels, background, typography, texture patterns, or its erroneous invisible tail/curl. Rebuild fur, eyes and fabric in fresh photoreal rendering. Smooth clean neutral light gray studio background, no paper texture, no patterned surface, no screen mesh or checkerboard, no moire, no crosshatching, no oversharpened furry noise. Individual soft fine fur strands, optically clean smooth eyes with crisp iris and natural catchlight. Premium live-action fantasy kitten, NOT plastic toy or illustration. Sunny optimistic little helper.

Deliver a high-resolution landscape TWO ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS turnaround sheet, 2048x1536 preferred, using nearly all canvas for LARGE full-body characters. Sparse labels only: title 'TILTSTAR • CLEAN BASE', row DAILY and TRAVEL, columns FRONT / LEFT / BACK / RIGHT. No detail panels on this sheet, no slogans/paragraphs/ornament. Eight standing poses of EXACT SAME kitten, one per cell, same scale and neutral expression, paws fully visible. Slight soft floor shadows. Top DAILY absolutely wingless; bottom TRAVEL same kitten with original small angel feather wings. Consistent identity and anatomy.

IDENTITY: round fluffy pale apricot-cream kitten, cream muzzle/chin/chest/paws, subtle pale apricot forehead markings, big warm amber irises black pupils, pink triangular nose, normal cat ears with pale pink interior, four normal feline legs and paws, compact softly plump torso, realistic fur. Match original reference front face, don't invent a breed or a long humanlike body. A muted sage-green triangular cloth bib tied behind neck, exactly two small olive sprout leaves embroidered centered near bib point.

SIGNATURE CURL (overrides incorrect original side/rear): ONE ivory-cream fluffy fur tuft rooted in CENTER upper forehead, at front edge of crown. Its BASE grows UPWARD, stem rises above central skull silhouette, TOP curls inward forming original front face's open C/crescent. Soft hair, not horn. Same modest volume/height in ALL EIGHT views: FRONT original upward open C; LEFT/RIGHT must show its UPWARD-raised stem above crown, not dangling brow curl or downward bangs. BACK shows SAME tuft's upper raised curl ABOVE central crown between ears, lower root naturally hidden by skull. One tuft only, no tiny duplicate lower loop. Turn the same 3D hair volume with the cat, not a new shape per view. Not an identical pasted symbol facing camera in all views.

TAIL: full-length fluffy apricot-cream cat tail, raised upward with rounded hooked/curled tip. It is IDENTICAL in daily and winged forms. In both BACK views, tail emerges at lower rump/sacrum, rises along image RIGHT side and gently hooks inward at tip, approximately reaching lower-head height. Same silhouette, length, thickness and height in BOTH rear views. Both side views show full tail naturally. No missing tail/stump/bobtail, no shortened tail to reveal wings. Tail can overlap feathers naturally, but no feather-tail or third wing. Tail is not a wing.

HALO: gently TILTED circular angel halo composed ONLY of warm-white emitted light with soft golden bloom, floating clear above ears/curl. ONE tiny luminous star floats by lower edge. Same ring/star in all eight views, pure light not gold metal, no physical chain, no supports or beams from ring to head. Maintain generous visible air gap from tuft.

WINGS in lower row ONLY: same natural ivory feather pair, softly layered short rounded wings growing from high shoulder back, restrained honey-gold terminal feather accents matching ref. No new giant wings. Wingless top no stubs. Lower back keep both wings AND complete long upright tail AND visible crown curl. Wings do not replace any feline body part.

NO bags, hats, tools, scarf redesign, new jewelry, extra decorative props. Natural quadruped poses. Preserve all identity anchors while giving completely fresh high-quality clean render. Eight views comfortably separated by whitespace or fine panel lines OUTSIDE character images; never any grid texture on fur/eyes/background. FRONT consistent across both rows. All halos,curls,ears,wings,tails and paws inside their cells unclipped. No per-cell repeating tile texture.

Generate a BRAND NEW CLEAN photographic character DETAIL SHEET for TILTSTAR, the exact kitten from supplied fresh turnaround reference. Reference is identity guide ONLY; draw fresh closeup pixels, never enlarge/crop/paste its panels. High-resolution landscape 2048x1536 preferred. Clean neutral light gray smooth studio background with softly lit fur. Clear crisp natural hair and eyes, no paper grain, no moire or grid on surfaces, no blocky fur, no blur/upscale artifacts, no plastic character. Sparse typography title 'TILTSTAR • DETAILS'. SIX generous closeup panels in 2 rows x 3 columns. Each panel unique useful detail, not full-body character repeated. All consistent with SAME kitten.

Panel 1 'FACE / AMBER EYES': large head-on face-and-upper-bib portrait, identity from reference: pale apricot cream fluffy kitten, round face, big warm amber iris black pupils, pink nose, ivory muzzle, normal pink-inside cat ears, SAME raised cream C-curl rising from center upper forehead, sage sprout bib. Halo + one star above, entire ears and curl unclipped. Fine whiskers/fur and recognizable expression, no extra doll eyelashes.
Panel 2 'UPRIGHT CURL': close anatomical view of head crown from front three-quarter, ONE fluffy ivory-cream fur tuft rooted at upper forehead midpoint, its base rises UP, upper end curves inward open C, same curl as front reference. Include TWO small separate side/rear mini-views inside panel to show same root, raised height and visible upper curl from back. No downward drooping bangs, no extra tiny loop at base, no horns.
Panel 3 'LIGHT HALO': enlarged gently tilted circular ring of SELF-EMITTED warm-white light, soft pale golden bloom, ONE small floating star next to low edge. Ring has visible opening, no solid metal/chain/wire/support/ray attaching it to head. Hint of ears low below ring to communicate air gap. Star pure light as reference, not solid pendant.
Panel 4 'IVORY + HONEY TIPS': enlarged SAME small layered feather wing from reference, ivory natural feathers with subtle honey-gold tip region; show wing attaches to shoulder/back in small contextual kitten rear three-quarter patch, not floating arm. Feathers organized, soft real texture. Not a new giant fantasy wing, no multiple wing pairs.
Panel 5 'FULL CURLED TAIL': enlarged rear three-quarter LOWER-body cat showing whole natural fluffy LONG apricotcream tail from sacrum to upright hooked rounded tip. Long tail same as reference, not stump, not extra wing. A modest second smaller winged-back comparison shows same long tail unchanged alongside wings. Include tail root correctly at lower rump, NEVER grow tail from shoulder. Tail can overlap feather tips naturally.
Panel 6 'SAGE SPROUT BIB': large close detail of muted sage triangular fabric bib on kitten's upper chest with two little olive-green sprout leaves and short stem stitched centered toward point. Show matching small rear-neck view for cloth tied knot, all same cloth/scale; not a bag strap. Ordinary plain soft woven fabric, very fine weave only on CLOTH not patterned onto fur.

No full turnaround grid on this detail sheet; this complements a separate eight-view sheet. No bags, caps, tools, extra costume or props. Same apricotcream fur, amber eyes, upright curl, light halo/star, full tail and ivory-gold wings. Only minimal panel labels, no long random generated prose. Fresh standalone generation rather than editing/upscaling previous sheets. Large detailed realistic closeups with well-defined clean surfaces.
